name: Tidal Wave
source:
Summer is suffocating. The sweltering heat, along with the ear piercing cicadas make it even more insufferable. None of that reaches you if you're a shut-in, though.

Tide is a regular shut-in. He doesn't leave his house unless it's an emergency, he doesn't have friends, he doesn't have a partner. But unlike a regular shut-in, he doesn't talk to AI.

So he downloads an AI chatbot. Maybe he will change or maybe he stays the same, that's up to him to decide.

[From [url=https://mintchiru.itch.io/tidal-wave]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏天令人窒息。酷暑难耐，蝉声刺耳，更让人难以忍受。不过，如果你是一个宅在家里的人，那么这些都不会影响到你。

潮汐是一种定期的关闭。除非有紧急情况，他不会离开家，他没有朋友，也没有伴侣。但与常规的关门不同的是，他不会与人工智能交谈。

于是他下载了一个人工智能聊天机器人。也许他会改变，也许他保持不变，这取决于他自己的决定。

[来自[url=https://mintchiru.itch.io/tidal-wave]itch.io[/url]]
